interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The postoperative pathology is reassuring, showing "surgical margins were negative" and "the seminal vesicles were not invaded." The surgical pathology reported a Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2) and pathological stage pT2, with no extraprostatic extension and no lymphovascular invasion. Countervailing findings include the lack of nodal sampling, as "no lymph nodes were removed," which means "pNx is not pN0," widening the uncertainty regarding nodal status. Preoperative PSA was 4.5. The absence of a postoperative PSA means biochemical recurrence cannot be assessed. Prognosis is supported by negative margins and no seminal vesicle invasion, but the unknown nodal status limits the complete staging. Information regarding the postoperative PSA and its subsequent trajectory is necessary to refine the prognosis. The fixed estimated horizon is 79.82 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 47.89–111.75 months; its coverage has not been validated.
